30010101.text: Alright, next let's see your right hand... Hmm, not bad.

30010102.text: But please remember that you still need to be careful, understand?

30010103.text: Yes, I will. By the way, Master, I still haven't received the patrol route for today.

30010104.text: Look, Collei, today's patrol will be a long one, so you won't be coming along this time. Besides, there's a chance we may encounter... Well, you understand.

30010105.text: But I have a Vision, too! Am I useless to everyone now...?

30010106.text: Don't talk like that, Collei. This is not something you need to be worrying about right now.

30010107.text: Ah, there you are. Feeling any better?

30010108.text: Is there something we can help with?

30010109.text: Yeah, since we'll be staying here for now, we thought we might as well try lending a hand around here.

30010110.text: Heh, seems you're not the type to sit back and take it easy for a while, huh. In that case, perhaps Collei could take you two for a patrol south of Gandharva Ville for the day.

30010111.text: And if you're feeling up to it, you can be responsible for cleaning the Statue of The Seven.

30010112.text: Tighnari, we're ready to head out!

30010113.text: Got it, I'll be right there! Alright, we'll be heading into the forest now. I'll leave any further details to Collei.

30010114.text: Yes, you can count on me!

30010115.text: So Collei, what exactly are we going to be doing today?

30010116.text: Tighnari mentioned cleaning the statue just now, but uh... that doesn't really sound like a job for a ranger.

30010117.text: Well, a Forest Ranger's responsibilities can be pretty diverse.

30010118.text: We handle a variety of tasks, like checking the condition of outlying roads, maintaining forest facilities, ensuring fire prevention standards are met, and providing assistance to travelers and locals.

30010119.text: As for Master, well, he has to handle more dangerous areas of the rainforest.

30010120.text: Today we can perform routine checks on the pathway lamps as we make our way to the Statue of The Seven.

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the lamps along the path
Check the lamps along the path

30010802.text: Welcome back! You must be tired after all that climbing. Let's take a little break.

30010803.text: Ah, by the way, Collei, have you ever seen any small creatures scurrying around in the forest? You know... that kinda look like a veggie?

30010804.text: A creature that looks like a veggie? Hmm... Well, I guess Master would say something like, "All plants are living organisms, so they also fall under the category of creatures."

30010805.text: You tell Collei about the thing you saw earlier.

30010806.text: Wow, fascinating! It almost sounds like an imaginary creature that you hear kids always talking about! I'll be sure to keep an eye out for anything like it.

30010807.text: Oh, I almost forgot. Are you two hungry? I packed some food and water for us.

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the lamps along the path

30010902.text: Welcome back! You must be tired after all that climbing. Let's take a little break now. I brought some food and water for us.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Statue of The Seven

30010501.text: The Statue of The Seven is up on top of that large rock formation. You must have seen it when you came down this road before.

30010502.text: It's pretty high up there, isn't it? Don't worry, if you're afraid you can't make it up there, I'm sure Master wouldn't mind if you don't clean the statue.

30010505.text: Oh? I guess I'll leave it up to you, then. There's not much footing once you reach the statue, so be careful up there.

30010506.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon'll fly up with you and help with those hard-to-reach areas.

30010507.text: Um, by the way, Collei, do you know anything about the Dendro Archon? You know, what's she like?

30010508.text: Uhh, that depends. Are you referring to Greater Lord Rukkhadevata or Lesser Lord Kusanali?

30010510.text: Oh, is that the name of the former Dendro Archon?

30010511.text: Uh-huh. Greater Lord Rukkhadevata was Sumeru's first Dendro Archon. She created the rainforests as well as the Wall of Samiel around the desert. Her works provided a means of peaceful living for everyone.

30010512.text: To the people of Sumeru, she is not only a symbol of wisdom but also of power and kindness. Unfortunately, she disappeared in a great calamity that occurred a few hundred years ago.

subQuests.subQuestName: Climb to the top of the rock
Resonate with the Dendro Archon Statue
Examine the Dendro Archon Statue before you

30010601.text: Huh, now that Paimon looks at it, the deity that's carved on the statue is... kinda small.

30010602.text: Hmm, do you think she's supposed to be Greater Lord Rukkhadevata or Lesser Lord Kusanali?

30010604.text: You might be right. The statue does look kinda old, hmm...

30010607.text: Well, anyway, we'll have to figure that out later. For now, let's focus on our job and clean up this—

30010610.text: Huh? Wait a sec! Is it just Paimon, or was there something moving!?

30010606.text: The name does seem to fit the statue somehow. Hmm...

30011001.text: Yay, food! What kind of goodies did you bring!?

30011003.text: Hey, don't be a party pooper! It's not like Collei is a stranger or anything. Besides, the best way to compliment a chef is to show passion for their food! Xiangling taught Paimon that.

30011004.text: I prepared a nice, portable dish that Forest Rangers like to eat, called Pita Pockets. I hope you'll like them...

30011006.text: AH! Nooo!!! You dropped it on the ground!

30011007.text: Not to worry! I wrapped a few layers of oiled paper around each pita. They should be fine.

30011008.text: Oh, whew... Paimon nearly had a heart attack there.

30011009.text: You enjoy the pitas together with Collei.

30011010.text: Those pitas are amazing! You're quite the cook, Collei.

30011011.text: Thank goodness you wrapped them in paper... Paimon wouldn't be able to sleep at night knowing something so tasty had been wasted.

30011012.text: Haha, you really know how to compliment the chef, Paimon.

30011013.text: Since you liked it so much, I'll be sure to give you a copy of the recipe sometime. I'll even include all my personal cooking pointers, so you'll be making your own Pita Pockets in no time.

30011014.text: Yay thanks, Collei! It's hard to believe someone as diligent as you could have clumsy moments too.

30011015.text: Oh, hehe... I guess it happens from time to time.

30011016.text: So uh, Collei... Don't you think that Tighnari's a little too strict with you? He won't let you touch anything without his permission.

30011017.text: #Paimon knocks stuff over all the time flying around the Traveler, but {NICKNAME}'s never said anything. Everyone has their clumsy moments!

30011018.text: No no, you've got the wrong idea about Master. Sure, he may seem a bit harsh at first. With some time, you'll see that he's actually very kindhearted.

30011019.text: I've heard the veteran rangers say that Master is from some ancient and mysterious race that is known for their cunning wit and reclusive nature. But Master is actually very kind at heart.

30011020.text: Oh, by the way, you've heard of the Akademiya, right? Well, there's a group called Am... uh, Amu something...

30011021.text: Well, anyway, because Master does a lot of research on plants, sages from the Akademiya have written him many times, inviting him to take up an official position there.

30011022.text: But Master declines their offers every time, saying, "Sumeru City is too noisy. It'd be bad for my ears."

30011024.text: Haha, seems you already know him well. Anyway, I'm sure the sages were not happy about his responses.

30011025.text: Master could obviously have a bright future in the Akademiya, but he insists on sticking to the path of a Forest Watcher. Every day, he helps the locals of the forest and passes on his extensive knowledge to trainees like me.

30011029.text: In fact, Master's the one who taught me how to make Pita Pockets.

30011030.text: Really? Paimon would've never guessed that.

30011031.text: Oh, speaking of Tighnari, he was the one who took care of you after finding you passed out yesterday. He even carried you all the way here.

30011032.text: Paimon's still kinda upset, though! He kept scolding Paimon the entire way here.

30011034.text: Oh no, I'm sorry. Master might've been overreacting a little...

30011035.text: #But it's mostly because Paimon wouldn't stop yelling, "Why, oh why!? Is {M#he}{F#she} going to die!?" It probably started to get under Master's skin after a while.

30011036.text: Hey! Argh, don't laugh!!! Paimon was genuinely concerned about you!

30011038.text: Hey! Now even Collei's starting to laugh!

30011039.text: Ughhh! That's it! Paimon won't forget this! It's time for some Paimonial wrath!

30011027.text: Hehehe, I know, right! I've always wanted to pet them, too. Ahem...

30011028.text: Anyway, Master could have easily left the rainforest to take up a position at the Akademiya. But he chose to stay here instead as a Forest Watcher, helping the locals every day and passing on his knowledge to trainees.

30011102.text: Yep, we're back. Uh, have you seen Collei by any chance?

30011103.text: Oh, Collei? Yes, I saw her go into her room just a moment ago.

30011104.text: Oh, okay... Guess we'll just have to wait and talk to her tomorrow then.

30010701.text: Huh, now that Paimon looks at it, the deity that's carved on the statue is... kinda small.

30010702.text: Hmm, do you think she's supposed to be Greater Lord Rukkhadevata or Lesser Lord Kusanali?

30010704.text: You might be right. The statue does look kinda old, hmm...

30010707.text: Well, anyway, we'll have to figure that out later.

30010708.text: Let's get started on cleaning the statue. Paimon'll fly up and take care of the top, and you clean everything below.

30010709.text: You and Paimon meticulously clean the statue.

30010706.text: The name does seem to fit the statue somehow. Hmm...

30015101.text: Uh, I'm not a very good climber, so I'll just let you handle the statue.

30015102.text: I'll go check the facilities up ahead. By the way, once we're done with our work here... would you like to chat some more?

30019901.text: Rise and shine! C'mon, it's time to go find Collei.

30019906.text: Hmm, no problems with this lamp. Good.

30019907.text: The Dendro Archon's Statue of The Seven is up there. You should try touching it like the other ones we've found on our journey.

30019908.text: Paimon bets you'll definitely get a response from the Dendro Archon.

30019909.text: Nice work, that's one clean statue! Let's head down and meet up with Collei.
